# Mycroft

> Mycroft is a set of local agents for investigative journalists and investigators, built on Osaurus (the local AI app for Mac) with an OpenKnowledge wiki. Mycroft and Spotlight run on on-device models in Osaurus; the Analyst files Spotlight findings and Scoutpost results into the wiki; Watson does web research in the cloud only when the member asks, through OpenRouter routed to Mistral's EU endpoints with zero data retention, and never sees the wiki. Navigator plans methods and Scoutpost monitors sources; both are hosted services.

Mycroft is installed through Buried Signals Engine. Indicator Labs submits the managed plan; open-source and agent-led users apply the same signed Engine plan directly. Provider keys stay in the macOS Keychain and enter through Indicator Labs' protected prompt or the public `bsig` stdin/keychain flow. No Mycroft localhost page collects credentials. No telemetry.
